ingredients.toddlerSafetyNote: Choose light tuna; limit to 1–2 toddler servings a week.

ingredients.name: Canned sardines (boneless, in water)

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs with Spinach & Cheddar
steps: Whisk 2 eggs with a splash of milk.
Wilt a handful of finely chopped spinach in the pan for 1 minute.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat until soft, moist curds form.
Serve with whole-wheat toast strips.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs with Tomato & Basil
steps: Whisk 2 eggs with a splash of milk.
Have quartered cherry tomatoes and torn basil ready to stir in at the end.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat until soft, moist curds form.
Serve with whole-wheat toast strips.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs with Mushroom & Parmesan
steps: Whisk 2 eggs with a splash of milk.
Sauté finely diced mushrooms in butter until very soft.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat until soft, moist curds form.
Serve with whole-wheat toast strips.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs with Zucchini & Feta
steps: Whisk 2 eggs with a splash of milk.
Grate zucchini, squeeze out the moisture, and soften it in the pan.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat until soft, moist curds form.
Serve with whole-wheat toast strips.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs with Sweet Potato Hash
steps: Whisk 2 eggs with a splash of milk.
Warm soft, diced roasted sweet potato and finely chopped pepper in the pan.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat until soft, moist curds form.
Serve with whole-wheat toast strips.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs with Flaked Salmon & Dill
steps: Whisk 2 eggs with a splash of milk.
Warm flaked cooked salmon (bones removed) with a dab of cream cheese and dill.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat until soft, moist curds form.
Serve with whole-wheat toast strips.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs with Black Beans & Avocado
steps: Whisk 2 eggs with a splash of milk.
Warm mashed black beans in the pan; top the finished eggs with diced avocado and a little salsa.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat until soft, moist curds form.
Serve with whole-wheat toast strips.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs with Broccoli & Cheddar
steps: Whisk 2 eggs with a splash of milk.
Finely chop steamed broccoli and warm it in the pan.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat until soft, moist curds form.
Serve with whole-wheat toast strips.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs with Ham & Peas
steps: Whisk 2 eggs with a splash of milk.
Warm finely diced ham and smashed peas in the pan.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat until soft, moist curds form.
Serve with whole-wheat toast strips.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Grate a peeled apple into the pot with a pinch of cinnamon.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Banana Peanut Butter Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Mash half a banana into the oats, then stir in 1 tsp peanut butter until fully melted in.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Stir in 2 tbsp pumpkin purée, cinnamon and a drop of maple syrup.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Blueberry Lemon Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Simmer smashed blueberries with the oats and add a little lemon zest.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Peaches & Cream Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Fold in soft diced peaches and a drop of vanilla.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Mango Coconut Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Cook the oats in half coconut milk; top with diced mango and finely shredded coconut.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate Banana Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Whisk in 1 tsp cocoa powder and mash in half a ripe banana.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Stir in finely grated carrot, cinnamon and finely chopped raisins; simmer until the carrot is soft.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Pear & Ginger Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Add grated peeled pear and a tiny pinch of grated ginger.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Strawberry Chia Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Stir in 1 tsp chia seeds and mashed strawberries; let stand 2 minutes so the chia softens.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: PB & J Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Swirl in a thin ribbon of peanut butter and mashed berries.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Stir in 2 tbsp mashed cooked sweet potato and cinnamon.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Raspberry Ricotta Oatmeal
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rolled oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Top with a spoon of ricotta and mashed raspberries.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for extra protein.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Berry Vanilla Overnight Oats
steps: Stir ¼ cup rolled oats, ¼ cup milk, ¼ cup Greek yogurt and 1 tsp chia seeds together in a jar.
Fold in mashed berries and a drop of vanilla.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until soft and spoonable.
Stir well and serve cold or gently warmed.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Overnight Oats
steps: Stir ¼ cup rolled oats, ¼ cup milk, ¼ cup Greek yogurt and 1 tsp chia seeds together in a jar.
Stir in 1 tsp peanut butter (fully mixed in) and mashed banana.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until soft and spoonable.
Stir well and serve cold or gently warmed.

recipes.title: Apple Pie Overnight Oats
steps: Stir ¼ cup rolled oats, ¼ cup milk, ¼ cup Greek yogurt and 1 tsp chia seeds together in a jar.
Swirl in 2 tbsp applesauce and a pinch of cinnamon.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until soft and spoonable.
Stir well and serve cold or gently warmed.

recipes.title: Mango Lassi Overnight Oats
steps: Stir ¼ cup rolled oats, ¼ cup milk, ¼ cup Greek yogurt and 1 tsp chia seeds together in a jar.
Fold in puréed mango and a tiny pinch of cardamom.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until soft and spoonable.
Stir well and serve cold or gently warmed.

recipes.title: Tropical Overnight Oats
steps: Stir ¼ cup rolled oats, ¼ cup milk, ¼ cup Greek yogurt and 1 tsp chia seeds together in a jar.
Use coconut milk for half the milk and fold in finely diced pineapple.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until soft and spoonable.
Stir well and serve cold or gently warmed.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake Overnight Oats
steps: Stir ¼ cup rolled oats, ¼ cup milk, ¼ cup Greek yogurt and 1 tsp chia seeds together in a jar.
Stir in finely grated carrot, cinnamon and finely chopped raisins.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until soft and spoonable.
Stir well and serve cold or gently warmed.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Overnight Oats
steps: Stir ¼ cup rolled oats, ¼ cup milk, ¼ cup Greek yogurt and 1 tsp chia seeds together in a jar.
Stir in 2 tbsp pumpkin purée and cinnamon.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until soft and spoonable.
Stir well and serve cold or gently warmed.

recipes.title: Chocolate Raspberry Overnight Oats
steps: Stir ¼ cup rolled oats, ¼ cup milk, ¼ cup Greek yogurt and 1 tsp chia seeds together in a jar.
Whisk in 1 tsp cocoa and fold in mashed raspberries.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until soft and spoonable.
Stir well and serve cold or gently warmed.

recipes.title: Kiwi Coconut Overnight Oats
steps: Stir ¼ cup rolled oats, ¼ cup milk, ¼ cup Greek yogurt and 1 tsp chia seeds together in a jar.
Top with finely diced kiwi and a sprinkle of shredded coconut.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until soft and spoonable.
Stir well and serve cold or gently warmed.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Blender Pancakes
steps: Blend 1 ripe banana, 2 eggs and ¼ cup oats until smooth.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Pancakes
steps: Whisk ¼ cup pumpkin purée, 1 egg, ½ cup flour, ⅓ cup milk, cinnamon and 1 tsp baking powder.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pancakes
steps: Blend ½ cup mashed sweet potato, 2 eggs, ¼ cup oats and cinnamon.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend ½ cup cottage cheese, 2 eggs and ⅓ cup oats until smooth.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Green Monster Spinach Pancakes
steps: Blend a handful of spinach, 1 banana, 1 egg, ½ cup oats and a splash of milk until bright green.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Blueberry Yogurt Pancakes
steps: Whisk ½ cup flour, 1 tsp baking powder, ¼ cup Greek yogurt, 1 egg and a splash of milk; fold in halved blueberries.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Pancakes
steps: Whisk ½ cup flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and ⅓ cup milk; fold in finely grated peeled apple and cinnamon.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake Pancakes
steps: Whisk ½ cup flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and ⅓ cup milk; fold in finely grated carrot and cinnamon.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
steps: Whisk ⅓ cup ricotta, 1 egg, lemon zest, ⅓ cup flour and 1 tsp baking powder.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Banana Pancakes
steps: Blend 1 banana, 2 eggs, ¼ cup oats and 1 tsp cocoa.

Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Savory Zucchini Cheddar Pancakes
steps: Mix grated, squeezed zucchini with 1 egg, 3 tbsp flour and shredded cheddar.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Pancakes
steps: Whisk 1 tbsp peanut butter (fully blended in) with mashed banana, 1 egg, ⅓ cup milk, ½ cup flour and 1 tsp baking powder.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Kefir Berry Pancakes
steps: Whisk ½ cup kefir, 1 egg, ½ cup flour and 1 tsp baking powder; fold in mashed berries.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Pear Ginger Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend a peeled ripe pear, a pinch of ginger, 2 eggs and ¼ cup oats.
Cook small silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low heat, 1–2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.
Freeze extras between sheets of parchment for busy mornings.

recipes.title: Mini Spinach & Feta Egg Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and grease a mini-muffin tin.
Whisk 6 eggs with ¼ cup milk.
Divide finely chopped spinach and feta among the cups, then pour in the egg mixture.
Bake 12–15 minutes until set; cool and halve for small hands.
Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze for quick breakfasts.

recipes.title: Mini Broccoli & Cheddar Egg Muffins

Divide finely chopped broccoli and cheddar among the cups, then pour in the egg mixture.

Bake 12–15 minutes until set; cool and halve for small hands.

Bake 12–15 minutes until set; cool and halve for small hands.

recipes.title: Mini Salmon & Dill Egg Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and grease a mini-muffin tin.
Whisk 6 eggs with ¼ cup milk.
Divide finely chopped salmon and fresh herbs among the cups, then pour in the egg mixture.
Bake 12–15 minutes until set; cool and halve for small hands.
Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze for quick breakfasts.

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and grease a mini-muffin tin.

Divide finely chopped cherry tomatoes and mozzarella among the cups, then pour in the egg mixture.

Divide finely chopped zucchini and cheddar among the cups, then pour in the egg mixture.

Divide finely chopped kale and potatoes among the cups, then pour in the egg mixture.
Bake 12–15 minutes until set; cool and halve for small hands.

recipes.title: Classic Cinnamon French Toast Fingers
steps: Whisk 1 egg with 3 tbsp milk.
Whisk cinnamon and a drop of vanilla into the custard.
Soak bread strips 10 seconds per side, then cook in a little butter over medium-low until golden and set.
Cool slightly and serve as fingers.

recipes.title: Pumpkin French Toast Fingers
steps: Whisk 1 egg with 3 tbsp milk.
Whisk 2 tbsp pumpkin purée and cinnamon into the custard.
Soak bread strips 10 seconds per side, then cook in a little butter over medium-low until golden and set.
Cool slightly and serve as fingers.

recipes.title: Banana Vanilla French Toast Fingers
steps: Whisk 1 egg with 3 tbsp milk.
Mash half a banana and a drop of vanilla into the custard.
Soak bread strips 10 seconds per side, then cook in a little butter over medium-low until golden and set.
Cool slightly and serve as fingers.

recipes.title: Berry-Stuffed French Toast Fingers
steps: Whisk 1 egg with 3 tbsp milk.
Sandwich a thin layer of cream cheese and mashed berries between two slices before dipping.
Soak bread strips 10 seconds per side, then cook in a little butter over medium-low until golden and set.
Cool slightly and serve as fingers.

recipes.title: Apple Pie French Toast Fingers
steps: Whisk 1 egg with 3 tbsp milk.
Add cinnamon to the custard and warm some applesauce for dipping.
Soak bread strips 10 seconds per side, then cook in a little butter over medium-low until golden and set.
Cool slightly and serve as fingers.

recipes.title: Coconut Mango French Toast Fingers
steps: Whisk 1 egg with 3 tbsp milk.
Use coconut milk in the custard and purée mango for dipping.
Soak bread strips 10 seconds per side, then cook in a little butter over medium-low until golden and set.
Cool slightly and serve as fingers.

recipes.title: Berry Crunch Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon ½ cup plain Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with mashed berries, soft-soaked oats and a sprinkle of hemp seeds.
Serve with a pre-loaded spoon so your toddler can practice self-feeding.

recipes.title: Mango Coconut Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon ½ cup plain Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with finely diced ripe mango and shredded coconut.
Serve with a pre-loaded spoon so your toddler can practice self-feeding.

recipes.title: Peach Melba Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon ½ cup plain Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with soft diced peaches and mashed raspberries.
Serve with a pre-loaded spoon so your toddler can practice self-feeding.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon ½ cup plain Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Swirl in 1 tsp peanut butter thinned with warm water; top with thin banana slices.
Serve with a pre-loaded spoon so your toddler can practice self-feeding.

recipes.title: Kiwi & Chia Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon ½ cup plain Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Stir in 1 tsp chia seeds, wait 5 minutes for them to soften, and top with finely diced kiwi.
Serve with a pre-loaded spoon so your toddler can practice self-feeding.

recipes.title: Apple Pie Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon ½ cup plain Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Swirl in applesauce and cinnamon; top with soft-soaked oats.
Serve with a pre-loaded spoon so your toddler can practice self-feeding.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon ½ cup plain Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Stir in pumpkin purée, cinnamon and a drop of maple syrup.
Serve with a pre-loaded spoon so your toddler can practice self-feeding.

recipes.title: Tropical Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon ½ cup plain Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with finely diced pineapple and mango and a little coconut.
Serve with a pre-loaded spoon so your toddler can practice self-feeding.

recipes.title: Strawberry Flax Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon ½ cup plain Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with quartered strawberries and a spoon of ground flaxseed.
Serve with a pre-loaded spoon so your toddler can practice self-feeding.

recipes.title: Avocado & Egg Toast Fingers
steps: Toast the bread and mash ripe avocado on top.
Top with a finely chopped hard-boiled egg.
Cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter & Banana Toast Fingers
steps: Toast the bread and spread a thin smear of peanut butter.
Top with thin banana slices and press down lightly.
Cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Ricotta, Berry & Honey Toast
steps: Toast the bread and spread with ricotta.
Top with mashed berries and a tiny drizzle of honey (12 months+ only).
Cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Hummus & Cucumber Toast
steps: Toast the bread and spread with hummus.
Top with paper-thin peeled cucumber slices.
Cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese & Tomato Toast
steps: Toast the bread and spread with cottage cheese.
Top with quartered cherry tomatoes and a drop of olive oil.
Cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Sardine & Avocado Toast
steps: Mash sardines with avocado and a squeeze of lemon, checking for any bones.
Spread on toast.
Cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cream Cheese Toast
steps: Toast the bread and spread a thin layer of cream cheese.
Top with thinly sliced strawberries.
Cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Sunflower Butter & Apple Toast
steps: Toast the bread and spread a thin smear of sunflower seed butter.
Top with grated or paper-thin peeled apple.
Cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Cheesy Bean Toast
steps: Mash warm beans onto toast.
Sprinkle with cheddar and broil 1 minute until melted.
Cool and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Tahini Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread and spread a thin layer of tahini.
Top with mashed banana and a pinch of cinnamon.
Cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Egg & Cheese Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Soft-scramble 1 egg and spread over half a tortilla with shredded cheddar.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Cool slightly and cut into small triangles.

recipes.title: Bean & Egg Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Spread mashed beans and soft-scrambled egg over half a tortilla with a little cheese.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Cool slightly and cut into small triangles.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Spread mashed sweet potato and black beans over half a tortilla; sprinkle with cheese.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Cool slightly and cut into small triangles.

recipes.title: Spinach, Egg & Feta Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Scramble an egg with chopped spinach and feta and spread over half a tortilla.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Cool slightly and cut into small triangles.

recipes.title: Spinach Banana Waffles
steps: Blend or whisk spinach, banana, flour, eggs and milk with the leavening and spices into a thick batter.
Cook in a lightly greased waffle iron until golden.
Cut into strips for dipping in Greek yogurt.
Freeze extras and re-crisp them in the toaster.

recipes.title: Vanilla Berry Chia Pudding
steps: Stir 2 tbsp chia seeds into ½ cup milk, wait 5 minutes, then stir again to break up clumps.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours (or overnight) until fully gelled. Chia must always be soaked.
Stir in vanilla and top with mashed berries.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Chocolate Banana Chia Pudding
steps: Stir 2 tbsp chia seeds into ½ cup milk, wait 5 minutes, then stir again to break up clumps.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours (or overnight) until fully gelled. Chia must always be soaked.
Whisk in 1 tsp cocoa and top with mashed banana.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Mango Coconut Chia Pudding
steps: Stir 2 tbsp chia seeds into ½ cup milk, wait 5 minutes, then stir again to break up clumps.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours (or overnight) until fully gelled. Chia must always be soaked.
Make it with half coconut milk and top with mango purée.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: PB & J Chia Pudding
steps: Stir 2 tbsp chia seeds into ½ cup milk, wait 5 minutes, then stir again to break up clumps.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours (or overnight) until fully gelled. Chia must always be soaked.
Swirl in 1 tsp peanut butter (fully mixed) and mashed berries.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Kefir Strawberry Chia Pudding
steps: Stir 2 tbsp chia seeds into ½ cup milk, wait 5 minutes, then stir again to break up clumps.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours (or overnight) until fully gelled. Chia must always be soaked.
Use kefir for half the milk and top with mashed strawberries.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Quinoa Porridge
steps: Simmer ¼ cup rinsed quinoa in ¾ cup milk for 15 minutes until very soft.
Stir in grated peeled apple and cinnamon for the last 5 minutes.
Cool to warm and serve.

recipes.title: Berry Quinoa Breakfast Bowl
steps: Simmer ¼ cup rinsed quinoa in ¾ cup milk until soft and creamy.
Fold in mashed berries.
Top with a spoon of Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Creamy Rice Pudding Porridge
steps: Simmer ½ cup cooked rice with ¾ cup milk for 10 minutes until creamy.
Stir in cinnamon and finely chopped raisins.
Cool to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Polenta Breakfast Bowl with Berries
steps: Whisk 3 tbsp polenta into 1 cup simmering milk and cook 8 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Top with mashed berries and a drop of maple syrup.
Cool to warm.

recipes.title: Cheesy Polenta with Soft Egg
steps: Cook polenta in milk until thick and creamy.
Stir in grated cheddar or parmesan.
Top with a finely chopped soft-scrambled egg.

recipes.title: Potato & Pea Frittata Fingers
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F / 190°C.
Soften finely chopped potatoes and peas in an oven-safe pan with a little oil.
Pour over 6 eggs whisked with ¼ cup milk and cook 2 minutes on the stove.
Bake 12–15 minutes until set; cool and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Spinach & Ricotta Frittata Fingers
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F / 190°C.
Soften finely chopped spinach and ricotta in an oven-safe pan with a little oil.
Pour over 6 eggs whisked with ¼ cup milk and cook 2 minutes on the stove.
Bake 12–15 minutes until set; cool and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Broccoli & Cheddar Frittata Fingers
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F / 190°C.
Soften finely chopped broccoli and cheddar in an oven-safe pan with a little oil.
Pour over 6 eggs whisked with ¼ cup milk and cook 2 minutes on the stove.
Bake 12–15 minutes until set; cool and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Zucchini & Tomato Frittata Fingers
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F / 190°C.
Soften finely chopped zucchini and cherry tomatoes in an oven-safe pan with a little oil.
Pour over 6 eggs whisked with ¼ cup milk and cook 2 minutes on the stove.
Bake 12–15 minutes until set; cool and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Kale & Feta Frittata Fingers
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F / 190°C.
Soften finely chopped kale and feta in an oven-safe pan with a little oil.
Pour over 6 eggs whisked with ¼ cup milk and cook 2 minutes on the stove.
Bake 12–15 minutes until set; cool and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato & Chicken Sausage Frittata Fingers
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F / 190°C.
Soften finely chopped sweet potato and chicken sausage in an oven-safe pan with a little oil.
Pour over 6 eggs whisked with ¼ cup milk and cook 2 minutes on the stove.
Bake 12–15 minutes until set; cool and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Mild Chicken & Ginger Congee
steps: Simmer ½ cup rice in 4 cups low-sodium broth with a slice of ginger for 60 minutes, stirring often, until porridge-like.
Stir in finely shredded cooked chicken and chopped spinach.
Remove the ginger and cool to warm.

recipes.title: Egg Drop Congee with Peas
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup rice in 3 cups low-sodium broth for 40 minutes until very soft.
Drizzle in a beaten egg while stirring to make silky ribbons.
Stir in smashed peas and cool to warm.

recipes.title: Savory Oatmeal with Egg & Cheese
steps: Cook ⅓ cup oats in low-sodium broth until creamy.
Stir in shredded cheese.
Top with a finely chopped soft-cooked egg.

recipes.title: Breakfast Sweet Potato Boats
steps: Microwave or roast a sweet potato until very soft; halve it.
Mash the flesh in the skin with cinnamon.
Top with Greek yogurt and a thin drizzle of peanut butter thinned with warm water.

recipes.title: Mild Shakshuka with Toast Soldiers
steps: Soften finely diced onion and pepper in a pan, then add crushed tomatoes and a pinch of cumin; simmer 8 minutes.
Make wells and crack in 2 eggs; cover and cook until the whites and yolks are fully set.
Serve with toast fingers for dipping.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble with Spinach
steps: Crumble firm tofu into a pan with a pinch of turmeric and cumin.
Stir in finely chopped spinach and cook until wilted.
Serve with toast strips.

recipes.title: Southwest Tofu Scramble
steps: Crumble tofu into a pan with finely diced pepper.
Add mashed black beans and a spoon of mild salsa; heat through.
Serve with warm tortilla strips.

recipes.title: Peaches & Cottage Cheese Bowl
steps: Spoon ⅓ cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with soft diced peaches and a pinch of cinnamon.

recipes.title: Savory Cottage Cheese & Cucumber Bowl
steps: Spoon ⅓ cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with finely diced peeled cucumber, quartered cherry tomatoes and a drop of olive oil.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burrito Bites
steps: Soft-scramble 2 eggs with mashed beans and cheese.
Roll tightly in a tortilla and toast seam-side down until golden.
Slice into 1-inch bites; serve with mild salsa.

recipes.title: Japanese-Style Breakfast Plate
steps: Make a thin rolled omelet (tamago) and slice it into strips.
Flake cooked salmon, checking for bones.
Serve with soft rice and smashed edamame.

recipes.title: Egg-in-a-Hole Toast
steps: Cut a hole in a slice of bread and toast it in butter.
Crack an egg into the hole and cook until fully set on both sides.
Cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Banana Bread Baked Oatmeal
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C.
Mix 2 cups oats, 2 mashed bananas, 2 eggs, 1½ cups milk, cinnamon and 1 tsp baking powder.
Bake in a greased dish for 30 minutes until set; cut into squares.

recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros Bites
steps: Toast small tortilla rounds until just crisp.
Spread with warm refried beans and top with a fully cooked scrambled egg.
Add a little mild salsa and mashed avocado.

recipes.title: Salmon & Cream Cheese English Muffin
steps: Toast an English muffin and spread with cream cheese.
Top with flaked cooked salmon and paper-thin cucumber.
Cut into small wedges.

recipes.title: Cheesy Egg English Muffin Sandwich
steps: Cook an egg flat in a small pan until fully set.
Sandwich in a toasted English muffin with a thin slice of cheese.
Cut into quarters.

recipes.title: Apple Slices with Cinnamon Yogurt Dip
steps: Peel and slice an apple paper-thin (or steam slices 2 minutes to soften).
Stir cinnamon into ¼ cup Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Pear Fingers with Vanilla Ricotta Dip
steps: Peel a very ripe pear and cut into soft fingers.
Whip ricotta with a drop of vanilla for dipping.

recipes.title: Banana Spears with Sunflower Butter Drizzle
steps: Cut a banana lengthwise into spears.
Thin 1 tsp sunflower seed butter with warm water and drizzle it thinly over the top.

recipes.title: Melon Sticks with Mint Yogurt
steps: Cut ripe melon into finger-size sticks.
Stir finely chopped mint into Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Strawberries with Chocolate Yogurt Dip
steps: Hull and quarter strawberries.
Whisk cocoa and a drop of maple syrup into Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Mango Spears with Coconut Yogurt
steps: Cut ripe mango into spears.
Stir finely shredded coconut into Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Peach Slices with Cottage Cheese
steps: Peel and slice a ripe peach into thin wedges.
Serve with a scoop of cottage cheese.

recipes.title: Kiwi Moons with Vanilla Yogurt
steps: Peel kiwi and cut into thin half-moons.
Serve with vanilla-flavored Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Steamed Apple Fingers with Peanut Butter Dip
steps: Steam peeled apple fingers 3 minutes until just soft.
Whisk 1 tsp peanut butter into 3 tbsp Greek yogurt for a thin, toddler-safe dip.

recipes.title: Pineapple with Lime Yogurt
steps: Cut ripe pineapple into thin sticks, removing the core.
Stir a little lime or lemon zest into Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Mandarin Segments with Cream Cheese Dip
steps: Peel mandarin segments and cut each in half.
Whip cream cheese with a splash of milk until dippable.

recipes.title: Blueberry Ricotta Rice Cakes
steps: Spread ricotta on a rice cake.
Top with smashed blueberries and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Oat & Sunflower Butter Bites
steps: Pulse oats, sunflower seed butter, honey and chia seeds in a food processor until the mixture holds together (any dried fruit must be fully blended).
Press into small, flattened discs. Flat is safer than round balls for little ones.
Chill 30 minutes. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Chocolate Date Bites
steps: Pulse dates, cocoa, oats and hemp seeds in a food processor until the mixture holds together (any dried fruit must be fully blended).
Press into small, flattened discs. Flat is safer than round balls for little ones.
Chill 30 minutes. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake Bites
steps: Pulse oats, carrot, dates, cinnamon and shredded coconut in a food processor until the mixture holds together (any dried fruit must be fully blended).
Press into small, flattened discs. Flat is safer than round balls for little ones.
Chill 30 minutes. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Bites
steps: Pulse oats, pumpkin purée, sunflower seed butter and cinnamon in a food processor until the mixture holds together (any dried fruit must be fully blended).
Press into small, flattened discs. Flat is safer than round balls for little ones.
Chill 30 minutes. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Lemon Coconut Bites
steps: Pulse oats, shredded coconut, lemon and dates in a food processor until the mixture holds together (any dried fruit must be fully blended).
Press into small, flattened discs. Flat is safer than round balls for little ones.
Chill 30 minutes. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Bites
steps: Pulse oats, peanut butter, banana and ground flaxseed in a food processor until the mixture holds together (any dried fruit must be fully blended).
Press into small, flattened discs. Flat is safer than round balls for little ones.
Chill 30 minutes. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Bites
steps: Pulse oats, applesauce, cinnamon and hemp seeds in a food processor until the mixture holds together (any dried fruit must be fully blended).
Press into small, flattened discs. Flat is safer than round balls for little ones.
Chill 30 minutes. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Tahini Date Bites
steps: Pulse oats, tahini, dates and cinnamon in a food processor until the mixture holds together (any dried fruit must be fully blended).
Press into small, flattened discs. Flat is safer than round balls for little ones.
Chill 30 minutes. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Mini Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and line a mini-muffin tin.
Mix banana, oats, eggs and Greek yogurt (finely grated or mashed) with the spices until just combined.
Fill cups ¾ full and bake 12–14 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely; freeze extras for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Zucchini Chocolate Mini Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and line a mini-muffin tin.
Mix zucchini, flour, cocoa, eggs and applesauce (finely grated or mashed) with the spices until just combined.
Fill cups ¾ full and bake 12–14 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely; freeze extras for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Carrot Apple Mini Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and line a mini-muffin tin.
Mix carrot, apple, flour and eggs (finely grated or mashed) with the spices until just combined.
Fill cups ¾ full and bake 12–14 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely; freeze extras for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Blueberry Yogurt Mini Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and line a mini-muffin tin.
Mix blueberries, Greek yogurt, flour and eggs (finely grated or mashed) with the spices until just combined.
Fill cups ¾ full and bake 12–14 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely; freeze extras for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Mini Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and line a mini-muffin tin.
Mix pumpkin purée, flour, eggs and maple syrup (finely grated or mashed) with the spices until just combined.
Fill cups ¾ full and bake 12–14 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely; freeze extras for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Mini Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and line a mini-muffin tin.
Mix sweet potato, oats and eggs (finely grated or mashed) with the spices until just combined.
Fill cups ¾ full and bake 12–14 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely; freeze extras for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Spinach Banana 'Hulk' Mini Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and line a mini-muffin tin.
Mix spinach, banana, oats and eggs (finely grated or mashed) with the spices until just combined.
Fill cups ¾ full and bake 12–14 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely; freeze extras for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Applesauce Oat Mini Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and line a mini-muffin tin.
Mix applesauce, oats and eggs (finely grated or mashed) with the spices until just combined.
Fill cups ¾ full and bake 12–14 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely; freeze extras for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Cheddar Broccoli Mini Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and line a mini-muffin tin.
Mix broccoli, cheddar, flour, eggs and milk (finely grated or mashed) with the spices until just combined.
Fill cups ¾ full and bake 12–14 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely; freeze extras for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Corn & Cheddar Mini Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C and line a mini-muffin tin.
Mix polenta, sweet corn, cheddar, eggs and milk (finely grated or mashed) with the spices until just combined.
Fill cups ¾ full and bake 12–14 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely; freeze extras for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Cucumber Sticks with Tzatziki
steps: Peel cucumber and cut into thin sticks.
Stir grated cucumber, dill and a squeeze of lemon into Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Soft Carrot Sticks with Hummus
steps: Steam carrot sticks 6–8 minutes until soft enough to squish.
Serve with hummus for dipping.

recipes.title: Steamed Pepper Strips with Guacamole
steps: Steam pepper strips 4 minutes until bendable.
Mash avocado with a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Baked Zucchini Fries with Yogurt Ranch
steps: Cut zucchini into sticks, dip in beaten egg, then in a panko and parmesan mix.
Bake at 425°F / 220°C for 18 minutes until golden.
Mix Greek yogurt with dill and chives for dipping.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Wedges with Black Bean Dip
steps: Roast sweet potato wedges at 425°F / 220°C for 25 minutes until soft inside.
Blend black beans with olive oil and a pinch of cumin until smooth.

recipes.title: Broccoli Trees with Cheese Sauce
steps: Steam broccoli florets until very tender.
Make a quick cheese sauce: melt butter, whisk in flour and milk, then stir in cheddar.

recipes.title: Green Beans with White Bean Dip
steps: Steam green beans until very tender.
Blend white beans with lemon and olive oil until smooth.

recipes.title: Edamame Hummus with Pita
steps: Blend thawed edamame with lemon, olive oil and a splash of water until very smooth.
Serve with soft pita triangles.

recipes.title: Hard-Boiled Egg & Avocado Mash on Crackers
steps: Mash a hard-boiled egg with ripe avocado.
Spread on crackers.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt 'Deviled' Eggs
steps: Halve hard-boiled eggs and mash the yolks with Greek yogurt and a pinch of paprika.
Spoon back into the whites; cut each half in two.

recipes.title: Mini Cheese Omelet Strips
steps: Whisk an egg with milk and cook a thin omelet with cheese until fully set.
Roll and slice into strips.

recipes.title: Egg Salad on Crackers
steps: Finely chop a hard-boiled egg and mix with Greek yogurt.
Spread on crackers.

recipes.title: Spinach Egg Mug Bites
steps: Whisk an egg with chopped spinach and cheese in a mug.
Microwave 60–90 seconds until fully set; cool and cut into cubes.

recipes.title: Berry Blast Smoothie
steps: Add berries, Greek yogurt, milk and banana to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Green Pineapple Kale Smoothie
steps: Add kale, melon, banana and kefir to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Tropical Sunshine Smoothie
steps: Add mango, melon, Greek yogurt and coconut milk to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: PB & J Smoothie
steps: Add peanut butter, berries, milk and oats to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Orange Creamsicle Smoothie
steps: Add mandarin, Greek yogurt, vanilla and milk to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Chocolate Banana Protein Smoothie
steps: Add cocoa, banana, milk, peanut butter and Greek yogurt to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler Smoothie
steps: Add mango, oats, Greek yogurt, cinnamon and milk to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Mango Lassi Smoothie
steps: Add mango, Greek yogurt, milk and mild spices to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Beet Berry Smoothie
steps: Add beets, berries, kefir and banana to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Smoothie
steps: Add pumpkin purée, banana, milk, cinnamon and Greek yogurt to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Avocado Banana Smoothie
steps: Add avocado, banana, milk and hemp seeds to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Kiwi Spinach Smoothie
steps: Add kiwi, spinach, banana and kefir to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cottage Cheese Smoothie
steps: Add strawberries, cottage cheese, milk and banana to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth with no chunks.
Serve in an open or straw cup; freeze leftovers as pops.

recipes.title: Berry Yogurt Bark
steps: Spread 1 cup Greek yogurt on a parchment-lined tray.
Top with mashed berries and a drizzle of honey (12 months+ only).
Freeze 2 hours and break into pieces; serve slightly softened.

recipes.title: Mango Coconut Yogurt Bark
steps: Spread Greek yogurt on a lined tray and swirl in mango purée.
Sprinkle with coconut and freeze 2 hours.
Break into pieces and let soften slightly.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Yogurt Bark
steps: Spread Greek yogurt on a lined tray.
Swirl in thinned peanut butter and top with mashed banana.
Freeze, break into pieces and soften slightly.

recipes.title: Frozen Yogurt Melts
steps: Blend Greek yogurt and berries until smooth.
Pipe small dots onto a lined tray.
Freeze until firm; they melt quickly in little mouths.

recipes.title: Chocolate Yogurt Frozen Banana Pops
steps: Halve bananas and insert a wide craft stick.
Dip in Greek yogurt mixed with cocoa.
Freeze 2 hours; let soften a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cottage Cheese 'Ice Cream'
steps: Blend cottage cheese, frozen strawberries and a little maple syrup until smooth.
Freeze 30 minutes for a soft-serve texture.

recipes.title: Cheddar & Apple Cracker Stacks
steps: Top crackers with thin cheddar slices.
Add a paper-thin slice of peeled apple.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese & Cucumber Rice Cakes
steps: Spread cream cheese on a rice cake.
Top with thin peeled cucumber and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Ricotta & Honey Crackers
steps: Spread ricotta on crackers.
Drizzle with a little honey (12 months+ only).

recipes.title: Mini Mozzarella & Tomato Bites
steps: Quarter cherry tomatoes lengthwise.
Toss with small pieces of fresh mozzarella and torn basil.

recipes.title: Parmesan Crisps with Pear
steps: Bake small mounds of grated parmesan at 400°F / 200°C for 5 minutes until lacy.
Serve with very ripe, peeled pear slices.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter & Banana Rice Cake
steps: Spread a thin smear of peanut butter on a rice cake.
Top with thin banana slices and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Hummus & Cucumber Rice Cake
steps: Spread hummus on a rice cake.
Top with paper-thin cucumber and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Avocado & Hemp Rice Cake
steps: Mash avocado onto a rice cake.
Sprinkle with hemp seeds and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Sunflower Butter & Strawberry Rice Cake
steps: Spread a thin smear of sunflower seed butter on a rice cake.
Top with thin strawberry slices and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Turkey & Cream Cheese Pinwheels
steps: Spread a thin, even layer of sliced turkey and cream cheese over a tortilla (grate any hard veggies finely).
Roll up tightly and chill 10 minutes to firm up.
Slice into ½-inch pinwheels.

recipes.title: Hummus Veggie Pinwheels
steps: Spread a thin, even layer of hummus, carrot and spinach over a tortilla (grate any hard veggies finely).
Roll up tightly and chill 10 minutes to firm up.
Slice into ½-inch pinwheels.

recipes.title: Sunflower Butter Banana Roll-Ups
steps: Spread a thin, even layer of sunflower seed butter and banana over a tortilla (grate any hard veggies finely).
Roll up tightly and chill 10 minutes to firm up.
Slice into ½-inch pinwheels.

recipes.title: Spinach & Mozzarella Pinwheels
steps: Spread a thin, even layer of spinach and mozzarella over a tortilla (grate any hard veggies finely).
Roll up tightly and chill 10 minutes to firm up.
Slice into ½-inch pinwheels.

recipes.title: Salmon & Cream Cheese Pinwheels
steps: Spread a thin, even layer of salmon, cream cheese and fresh herbs over a tortilla (grate any hard veggies finely).
Roll up tightly and chill 10 minutes to firm up.
Slice into ½-inch pinwheels.

recipes.title: Classic Hummus with Soft Pita
steps: Blend chickpeas with tahini, lemon, olive oil and a splash of water until very smooth.
Serve with soft dippers cut into strips or triangles.

recipes.title: Beet Hummus with Pita
steps: Blend chickpeas with cooked beets, tahini and lemon until bright pink and smooth.
Serve with soft dippers cut into strips or triangles.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Hummus with Crackers
steps: Blend chickpeas with roasted sweet potato and tahini until smooth.
Serve with soft dippers cut into strips or triangles.

recipes.title: White Bean & Herb Dip with Pita
steps: Blend white beans with herbs, lemon and olive oil until smooth.
Serve with soft dippers cut into strips or triangles.

recipes.title: Avocado Hummus with Crackers
steps: Blend chickpeas with ripe avocado and lemon until creamy.
Serve with soft dippers cut into strips or triangles.

recipes.title: Mini Cheese & Bean Quesadillas
steps: Spread mashed beans and cheese on half a small tortilla and fold.
Toast in a dry pan until golden; cut into strips.

recipes.title: Apple Cheddar Quesadilla
steps: Layer grated apple and cheddar on half a tortilla and fold.
Toast until melted; cut into small triangles.

recipes.title: Pita Pizza Bites
steps: Spread marinara on pita and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 8 minutes; cut into small squares.

recipes.title: English Muffin Mini Pizzas
steps: Top English muffin halves with marinara, mozzarella and finely diced pepper.
Bake 8–10 minutes until bubbly; cool and cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Spinach Pesto Mozzarella Pita
steps: Blend spinach, parmesan and olive oil into a nut-free pesto.
Spread on pita, top with mozzarella and bake 8 minutes; cut into strips.

recipes.title: Applesauce Oat Bars
steps: Mix 2 cups oats, 1 cup applesauce, 1 egg and cinnamon.
Press into a lined pan and bake at 350°F / 175°C for 25 minutes.
Cool and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Berry Baked Oatmeal Squares
steps: Mix oats, mashed berries, eggs, milk and baking powder.
Bake at 350°F / 175°C for 30 minutes until set.
Cut into soft squares.

recipes.title: Banana Bread Fingers
steps: Mix 3 mashed bananas, 2 eggs, melted butter, 1½ cups flour and baking powder.
Bake in a loaf pan at 350°F / 175°C for 45 minutes.
Slice and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Oat Bars
steps: Mix oats, pumpkin purée, eggs, a little maple syrup and cinnamon.
Bake at 350°F / 175°C for 25 minutes.
Cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread Fingers
steps: Mix grated zucchini, applesauce, eggs, flour, cinnamon and baking powder.
Bake in a loaf pan at 350°F / 175°C for 45 minutes.
Slice into fingers.

recipes.title: No-Bake Sunflower Oat Bars
steps: Warm sunflower seed butter with honey and stir in oats and flaxseed.
Press firmly into a lined pan and chill 1 hour.
Cut into thin bars.

recipes.title: Edamame Smash on Crackers
steps: Mash thawed, steamed edamame with lemon until smooth.
Spread on crackers.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Toast Bites
steps: Roast thin sweet potato slices until soft.
Top with a thin smear of peanut butter and mashed banana.

recipes.title: Baked Avocado Fries
steps: Cut firm-ripe avocado into wedges, dip in egg and panko.
Bake at 425°F / 220°C for 12 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Soft Fruit & Cheese Stacks
steps: Cut melon, kiwi and cheese into thin, flat squares.
Stack them in mini towers (no skewers).

recipes.title: Chia Jam Toast Strips
steps: Simmer berries 5 minutes, mash, and stir in chia seeds; let thicken 10 minutes.
Spread on toast and cut into strips.

recipes.title: Mashed Chickpea Salad Crackers
steps: Mash chickpeas with Greek yogurt and lemon.
Spread on crackers.

recipes.title: Kefir Berry Popsicles
steps: Blend kefir, berries and a little honey (12 months+ only).
Freeze in small pop molds.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Baked Apple Rings
steps: Slice peeled, cored apples into thin rings and dust with cinnamon.
Bake at 375°F / 190°C for 15 minutes until soft; serve with yogurt.

recipes.title: Tuna Melt Cracker Bites
steps: Mix drained tuna with a little shredded cheese.
Spoon onto crackers and broil 1 minute until melted.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Mac & Cheese
steps: Cook pasta until very soft; drain.
Melt 1 tbsp butter, whisk in 1 tbsp flour, then 1 cup milk; simmer until thickened.
Blend 1 cup roasted butternut squash into the sauce.
Stir in shredded cheddar off the heat and toss with the pasta.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Mac & Cheese
steps: Cook pasta until very soft; drain.
Melt 1 tbsp butter, whisk in 1 tbsp flour, then 1 cup milk; simmer until thickened.
Stir in finely chopped, very soft steamed cauliflower.
Stir in shredded cheddar off the heat and toss with the pasta.

recipes.title: Broccoli Mac & Cheese
steps: Cook pasta until very soft; drain.
Melt 1 tbsp butter, whisk in 1 tbsp flour, then 1 cup milk; simmer until thickened.
Fold in finely chopped steamed broccoli.
Stir in shredded cheddar off the heat and toss with the pasta.

recipes.title: Ham & Pea Mac & Cheese
steps: Cook pasta until very soft; drain.
Melt 1 tbsp butter, whisk in 1 tbsp flour, then 1 cup milk; simmer until thickened.
Fold in finely diced ham and smashed peas.
Stir in shredded cheddar off the heat and toss with the pasta.

recipes.title: Tuna Mac & Cheese
steps: Cook pasta until very soft; drain.
Melt 1 tbsp butter, whisk in 1 tbsp flour, then 1 cup milk; simmer until thickened.
Fold in drained, flaked tuna and peas.
Stir in shredded cheddar off the heat and toss with the pasta.

recipes.title: Spinach & White Bean Mac & Cheese
steps: Cook pasta until very soft; drain.
Melt 1 tbsp butter, whisk in 1 tbsp flour, then 1 cup milk; simmer until thickened.
Blend spinach and white beans into the sauce for hidden protein and iron.
Stir in shredded cheddar off the heat and toss with the pasta.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Chicken Mac & Cheese
steps: Cook pasta until very soft; drain.
Melt 1 tbsp butter, whisk in 1 tbsp flour, then 1 cup milk; simmer until thickened.
Blend mashed sweet potato into the sauce and fold in finely shredded cooked chicken.
Stir in shredded cheddar off the heat and toss with the pasta.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Sandwich Fingers
steps: Finely shred cooked chicken and mix with Greek yogurt and grated apple.
Spread on bread and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Egg Salad Sandwich Fingers
steps: Finely chop hard-boiled eggs and mix with Greek yogurt and a little dill.
Spread on bread and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Salmon Salad Sandwich Fingers
steps: Mash canned salmon with Greek yogurt and lemon, checking for bones.
Spread on bread and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Turkey, Avocado & Cheese Sandwich Fingers
steps: Spread mashed avocado on bread.
Layer thin turkey strips and a thin slice of cheese; cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Hummus & Grated Veggie Sandwich
steps: Spread hummus on bread.
Top with finely grated carrot and cucumber; cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese & Apple Fingers
steps: Layer cheddar and paper-thin peeled apple between bread.
Grill in butter until golden and melted; cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese & Cucumber Tea Sandwiches
steps: Spread cream cheese mixed with dill on bread.
Add paper-thin peeled cucumber and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Smashed Chickpea 'Tuna' Salad Sandwich
steps: Mash chickpeas with Greek yogurt and lemon.
Spread on bread and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Mozzarella, Tomato & Basil Panini
steps: Fill bread with mozzarella, quartered cherry tomatoes and basil.
Press in a hot pan with a little oil until melted; cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Sardine Salad Sandwich
steps: Mash sardines with Greek yogurt and lemon, checking for bones.
Spread on bread and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Ham & Cheese Toastie
steps: Fill bread with thin ham and cheese.
Toast in butter until golden and melted; cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Shredded Chicken Quesadilla
steps: Spread chicken thighs and cheddar (shredded, mashed or finely chopped) over half a tortilla.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cool slightly and cut into small triangles; serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Black Bean & Corn Quesadilla
steps: Spread beans, sweet corn and cheddar (shredded, mashed or finely chopped) over half a tortilla.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cool slightly and cut into small triangles; serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato & Mozzarella Quesadilla
steps: Spread sweet potato and mozzarella (shredded, mashed or finely chopped) over half a tortilla.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cool slightly and cut into small triangles; serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Spinach & Mozzarella Quesadilla
steps: Spread spinach and mozzarella (shredded, mashed or finely chopped) over half a tortilla.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cool slightly and cut into small triangles; serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Refried Bean & Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Spread refried beans and cheddar (shredded, mashed or finely chopped) over half a tortilla.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cool slightly and cut into small triangles; serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Salmon & Avocado Quesadilla
steps: Spread salmon, avocado and mozzarella (shredded, mashed or finely chopped) over half a tortilla.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cool slightly and cut into small triangles; serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork & Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Spread pork shoulder, cheddar and mild salsa (shredded, mashed or finely chopped) over half a tortilla.
Fold and toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cool slightly and cut into small triangles; serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Turkey & Spinach Mini Meatballs
steps: Combine ground turkey, spinach, panko, eggs and cheddar (grate or finely chop any veggies) and mix well.
Shape into small, flat patties or slightly flattened balls (flat is safer for toddlers).
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 15–18 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C).
Cool, cut in half, and serve with marinara for dipping.

recipes.title: Beef & Veggie Mini Meatballs
steps: Combine ground beef, carrot, zucchini, panko and eggs (grate or finely chop any veggies) and mix well.
Shape into small, flat patties or slightly flattened balls (flat is safer for toddlers).
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 15–18 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C).
Cool, cut in half, and serve with marinara for dipping.

recipes.title: Chicken Zucchini Meatballs
steps: Combine ground chicken, zucchini, panko and eggs (grate or finely chop any veggies) and mix well.
Shape into small, flat patties or slightly flattened balls (flat is safer for toddlers).
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 15–18 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C).
Cool, cut in half, and serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Lentil 'Meatballs'
steps: Combine lentils, oats, eggs and cheddar (grate or finely chop any veggies) and mix well.
Shape into small, flat patties or slightly flattened balls (flat is safer for toddlers).
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden.
Cool, cut in half, and serve with marinara for dipping.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon Cakes
steps: Combine salmon, potatoes, eggs, panko and fresh herbs (grate or finely chop any veggies) and mix well.
Shape into small, flat patties or slightly flattened balls (flat is safer for toddlers).
Pan-fry in a little oil, 3 minutes per side, until golden and hot through.
Cool, cut in half, and serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Tuna Patties
steps: Combine canned tuna, eggs, panko and lemon (grate or finely chop any veggies) and mix well.
Shape into small, flat patties or slightly flattened balls (flat is safer for toddlers).
Pan-fry in a little oil, 3 minutes per side, until golden and hot through.
Cool, cut in half, and serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Zucchini Feta Fritters
steps: Combine zucchini, eggs, flour and feta (grate or finely chop any veggies) and mix well.
Shape into small, flat patties or slightly flattened balls (flat is safer for toddlers).
Pan-fry in a little oil, 3 minutes per side, until golden and hot through.
Cool, cut in half, and serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Patties
steps: Combine sweet potato, beans, oats and mild spices (grate or finely chop any veggies) and mix well.
Shape into small, flat patties or slightly flattened balls (flat is safer for toddlers).
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden.
Cool, cut in half, and serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Bites
steps: Combine broccoli, cheddar, eggs and panko (grate or finely chop any veggies) and mix well.
Shape into small, flat patties or slightly flattened balls (flat is safer for toddlers).
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden.
Cool, cut in half, and serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Quinoa Veggie Bites
steps: Combine quinoa, carrot, eggs and cheddar (grate or finely chop any veggies) and mix well.
Shape into small, flat patties or slightly flattened balls (flat is safer for toddlers).
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden.
Cool, cut in half, and serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Baked Falafel with Yogurt Sauce
steps: Combine beans, fresh herbs, flour, mild spices and lemon (grate or finely chop any veggies) and mix well.
Shape into small, flat patties or slightly flattened balls (flat is safer for toddlers).
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden.
Cool, cut in half, and serve with Greek yogurt for dipping.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese Strips
steps: Simmer crushed tomatoes with softened onion and broth for 15 minutes; blend smooth and stir in a splash of milk.
Make a grilled cheese and cut it into strips for dunking.
Cool the soup to warm before serving.

recipes.title: Cozy Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer chicken thighs in broth with diced carrot and onion for 25 minutes.
Shred the chicken finely and return it to the pot with egg noodles and peas; cook until very soft.
Cool to warm.

recipes.title: Mild Minestrone
steps: Simmer diced carrot and zucchini in broth and crushed tomatoes for 15 minutes.
Add small pasta and white beans; cook until the pasta is very soft.
Mash a few beans to thicken; cool to warm.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Soup
steps: Simmer cubed squash and onion in broth for 20 minutes until soft.
Blend until silky.
Swirl in Greek yogurt and serve warm.

recipes.title: Red Lentil & Carrot Soup
steps: Simmer red lentils, diced carrot and onion in broth with a pinch of cumin for 20 minutes.
Blend smooth or leave slightly chunky.
Cool to warm.

recipes.title: Split Pea Soup with Ham
steps: Simmer split peas and diced carrot in broth for 50 minutes until completely soft.
Stir in finely diced ham.
Blend partly for a smooth, thick texture.

recipes.title: White Bean & Kale Soup
steps: Simmer diced potato in broth for 10 minutes.
Add white beans and very finely chopped kale; simmer 10 more minutes until soft.
Top with grated parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken & Rice Soup
steps: Poach chicken in broth with diced carrot for 20 minutes; shred finely.
Add cooked rice and simmer until thick.
Cool to warm.

recipes.title: Sweet Corn Chowder
steps: Simmer diced potato and onion in broth until soft.
Add corn and milk; blend half the soup so it's thick and creamy and no whole kernels remain loose.
Cool to warm.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Simmer broccoli and potato in broth for 15 minutes.
Blend with milk until smooth.
Stir in cheddar until melted.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato & Carrot Ginger Soup
steps: Simmer sweet potato and carrot in broth with a slice of ginger for 20 minutes.
Remove the ginger and blend with coconut milk.
Cool to warm.

recipes.title: Mild Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Simmer chicken in broth with tomatoes, beans and corn for 25 minutes; shred chicken finely.
Top with soft tortilla strips and diced avocado.
Cool to warm.

recipes.title: Mild Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
steps: Simmer shredded cooked chicken in a little low-sodium soy sauce and honey (12 months+) until glazed.
Serve over soft rice with finely chopped steamed broccoli.

recipes.title: Salmon & Avocado Rice Bowl
steps: Flake cooked salmon, checking for bones.
Serve over rice with diced avocado, thin peeled cucumber and a drop of low-sodium soy sauce.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu & Veggie Rice Bowl
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes until golden; cut into small pieces.
Serve over rice with steamed grated carrot and smashed edamame.

recipes.title: Veggie Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble an egg in a pan and set aside.
Fry cold cooked rice with mixed vegetables until hot; stir in the egg and a drop of soy sauce.

recipes.title: Black Bean Burrito Bowl
steps: Warm and lightly mash black beans with corn.
Arrange with rice, diced avocado, shredded cheese and a little mild salsa.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Rice Bowl
steps: Shred lemon-oregano chicken finely.
Serve over rice with peeled cucumber and a dill yogurt sauce.

recipes.title: Nut-Free Spinach Pesto Pasta
steps: Blend spinach, basil, parmesan, olive oil and hemp seeds into a smooth pesto.
Toss with soft-cooked pasta and a splash of pasta water.

recipes.title: Tomato Lentil Pasta
steps: Simmer red lentils in crushed tomatoes with softened onion for 20 minutes.
Toss with soft-cooked pasta.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken & Broccoli Pasta
steps: Simmer milk with grated parmesan until slightly thick.
Toss with pasta, finely shredded chicken and chopped steamed broccoli.

recipes.title: Tuna & Pea Pasta
steps: Mix flaked tuna, peas, Greek yogurt and lemon.
Toss with warm pasta.

recipes.title: Butter Noodles with Peas & Parmesan
steps: Cook egg noodles until very soft.
Toss with butter, smashed peas and grated parmesan.

recipes.title: Ricotta Spinach Stuffed Shells
steps: Fill cooked shells with ricotta mixed with chopped spinach.
Top with marinara and mozzarella; bake at 375°F / 190°C for 20 minutes.
Cut shells in half to serve.

recipes.title: Orzo with Peas & Parmesan
steps: Cook orzo in broth until soft and creamy.
Stir in peas, butter and parmesan.

recipes.title: Creamy Avocado Pasta
steps: Blend avocado, lemon and parmesan with a splash of pasta water.
Toss with warm pasta.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Sage Pasta
steps: Warm pumpkin purée with milk, parmesan and a little sage.
Toss with soft-cooked pasta.

recipes.title: Sardine & Tomato Pasta
steps: Simmer crushed tomatoes with garlic and mashed sardines for 10 minutes.
Toss with soft pasta.

recipes.title: Couscous with Chickpeas & Cucumber
steps: Fluff couscous and mix with lightly mashed chickpeas, finely diced peeled cucumber, lemon and olive oil.
Serve at room temperature with a spoon or as finger-food clumps.

recipes.title: Rainbow Quinoa Salad
steps: Mix soft-cooked quinoa with steamed diced pepper, corn and smashed edamame.
Serve at room temperature with a spoon or as finger-food clumps.

recipes.title: Greek Orzo Salad
steps: Toss orzo with peeled cucumber, crumbled feta, quartered cherry tomatoes and olive oil.
Serve at room temperature with a spoon or as finger-food clumps.

recipes.title: Rice & Bean Salad
steps: Toss rice with lightly mashed beans, corn, diced avocado and lemon.
Serve at room temperature with a spoon or as finger-food clumps.

recipes.title: Loaded Sweet Potato with Black Beans
steps: Microwave the potato 6–8 minutes (or bake 45 minutes) until very soft.
Halve it and fluff the inside.
Mash the flesh with black beans; top with cheese and Greek yogurt.
Cool, then scoop into a bowl or serve in small pieces.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Baked Potato
steps: Microwave the potato 6–8 minutes (or bake 45 minutes) until very soft.
Halve it and fluff the inside.
Mash the flesh with milk, finely chopped broccoli and cheddar.
Cool, then scoop into a bowl or serve in small pieces.

recipes.title: Tuna Melt Baked Potato
steps: Microwave the potato 6–8 minutes (or bake 45 minutes) until very soft.
Halve it and fluff the inside.
Mash the flesh with tuna and Greek yogurt; top with cheese and broil 1 minute.
Cool, then scoop into a bowl or serve in small pieces.

recipes.title: Chili-Topped Baked Potato
steps: Microwave the potato 6–8 minutes (or bake 45 minutes) until very soft.
Halve it and fluff the inside.
Top with a mild beef and bean chili and a sprinkle of cheese.
Cool, then scoop into a bowl or serve in small pieces.

recipes.title: Homemade Chicken Nuggets
steps: Cut chicken into small, flat strips.
Dip in beaten egg (or flour), then coat in panko.
Bake at 425°F / 220°C for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with a Greek yogurt ranch dip.

recipes.title: Crispy Fish Nuggets
steps: Cut fish into small strips and check for bones.
Dip in beaten egg (or flour), then coat in panko.
Bake at 425°F / 220°C for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with a Greek yogurt ranch dip.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu Nuggets
steps: Press tofu, cut into small flat pieces and toss in a drop of soy sauce.
Dip in beaten egg (or flour), then coat in panko.
Bake at 425°F / 220°C for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with a Greek yogurt ranch dip.

recipes.title: Veggie Nuggets
steps: Mash steamed broccoli, carrot and potato with cheese and shape into small flat nuggets.
Dip in beaten egg (or flour), then coat in panko.
Bake at 425°F / 220°C for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with a Greek yogurt ranch dip.

recipes.title: Turkey & Sweet Potato Nuggets
steps: Mix ground turkey with mashed sweet potato and shape into small flat nuggets.
Dip in beaten egg (or flour), then coat in panko.
Bake at 425°F / 220°C for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with a Greek yogurt ranch dip.

recipes.title: Veggie Pita Pizza
steps: Top pita with marinara, mozzarella and finely diced zucchini and mushrooms.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 8–10 minutes until bubbly (skip for no-bake toppings).
Cool and cut into small squares.

recipes.title: Margherita Tortilla Pizza
steps: Top a tortilla with marinara, mozzarella and torn basil.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 8–10 minutes until bubbly (skip for no-bake toppings).
Cool and cut into small squares.

recipes.title: Chicken & Spinach Flatbread
steps: Brush pita with olive oil and top with shredded chicken, chopped spinach and mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 8–10 minutes until bubbly (skip for no-bake toppings).
Cool and cut into small squares.

recipes.title: Hummus & Veggie Flatbread
steps: Spread hummus on warm pita and top with peeled cucumber, quartered tomatoes and feta (no baking needed).
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 8–10 minutes until bubbly (skip for no-bake toppings).
Cool and cut into small squares.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar-Style Wrap
steps: Layer finely chopped chicken breast, Greek yogurt, cheddar and spinach over a warm tortilla.
Roll up tightly.
Slice into 1-inch pinwheels.

recipes.title: Smashed Chickpea & Hummus Wrap
steps: Layer finely chopped beans, hummus and cucumber over a warm tortilla.
Roll up tightly.
Slice into 1-inch pinwheels.

recipes.title: Turkey, Cheese & Spinach Wrap
steps: Layer finely chopped sliced turkey, cheddar and spinach over a warm tortilla.
Roll up tightly.
Slice into 1-inch pinwheels.

recipes.title: Shrimp & Avocado Wrap
steps: Layer finely chopped shrimp, avocado and Greek yogurt over a warm tortilla.
Roll up tightly.
Slice into 1-inch pinwheels.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Snack Plate
steps: Arrange hummus, pita, cucumber, feta and cherry tomatoes in separate sections of a divided plate.
Prepare each item using the safety guide (steam hard veggies, quarter round foods).
Include a dip to encourage tasting, and let your toddler choose what and how much to eat.

recipes.title: Mexican Fiesta Plate
steps: Arrange refried beans, tortilla, avocado, cheddar and mandarin in separate sections of a divided plate.
Prepare each item using the safety guide (steam hard veggies, quarter round foods).
Include a dip to encourage tasting, and let your toddler choose what and how much to eat.

recipes.title: Japanese-Inspired Bento Box
steps: Arrange rice, eggs, edamame, cucumber and mandarin in separate sections of a divided plate.
Prepare each item using the safety guide (steam hard veggies, quarter round foods).
Include a dip to encourage tasting, and let your toddler choose what and how much to eat.

recipes.title: Ploughman's Toddler Plate
steps: Arrange cheddar, ham, apple and whole-wheat bread in separate sections of a divided plate.
Prepare each item using the safety guide (steam hard veggies, quarter round foods).
Include a dip to encourage tasting, and let your toddler choose what and how much to eat.

recipes.title: Rainbow Veggie Plate with Hummus
steps: Arrange hummus, carrot, bell pepper, cucumber and blueberries in separate sections of a divided plate.
Prepare each item using the safety guide (steam hard veggies, quarter round foods).
Include a dip to encourage tasting, and let your toddler choose what and how much to eat.

recipes.title: Brunch Plate
steps: Arrange eggs, whole-wheat bread, banana, Greek yogurt and strawberries in separate sections of a divided plate.
Prepare each item using the safety guide (steam hard veggies, quarter round foods).
Include a dip to encourage tasting, and let your toddler choose what and how much to eat.

recipes.title: Cheesy Polenta with White Beans & Spinach
steps: Cook polenta in broth until thick and creamy; stir in parmesan.
Warm white beans with chopped spinach until wilted.
Spoon the beans over the polenta.

recipes.title: Lemon Spinach Risotto
steps: Toast rice in butter, then add warm broth a ladle at a time, stirring, for 20 minutes.
Stir in chopped spinach, lemon zest and parmesan.
Cool to warm.

recipes.title: Mini Turkey Sliders
steps: Shape ground turkey into small, thin patties and cook until 165°F / 74°C.
Serve on small rounds of bread with a slice of cheese.
Cut each slider in half; serve with thin cucumber.

recipes.title: Veggie Omelet Strips
steps: Soften finely chopped pepper and spinach in a pan.
Add 2 whisked eggs and cheese; cook until fully set, then flip.
Slice into strips.

recipes.title: Ham & Cheese Savory Crêpes
steps: Whisk flour, egg and milk into a thin batter and cook thin crêpes.
Fill with finely diced ham and cheese and fold into quarters; warm until melted.
Cut into strips.

recipes.title: Peanut Noodles with Cucumber & Edamame
steps: Whisk peanut butter with warm water and a drop of soy sauce into a thin, smooth sauce.
Toss with soft noodles, peeled cucumber strips and smashed edamame.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Chicken Thighs with Potatoes & Carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F / 220°C.
Toss small potato chunks and carrot sticks with olive oil and roast 15 minutes.
Add chicken thighs rubbed with lemon and herbs; roast 25 minutes until 165°F / 74°C.
Shred the chicken and serve with the soft veggies.

recipes.title: Maple Salmon with Sweet Potatoes & Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F / 220°C.
Roast sweet potato cubes with oil for 15 minutes; add broccoli.
Add salmon brushed with a little maple syrup; roast 12 minutes until it flakes.
Flake the salmon, checking for bones.

recipes.title: Parmesan-Crusted White Fish with Green Beans
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F / 220°C and roast potato wedges for 15 minutes.
Top fish with a parmesan-panko crust and add to the pan with green beans.
Roast 12 minutes until the fish flakes; check for bones.

recipes.title: Crispy Sheet-Pan Tofu with Broccoli & Rice
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F / 220°C.
Toss pressed tofu cubes and broccoli with oil and a drop of soy sauce.
Roast 25 minutes, flipping once, until golden.
Serve over soft rice; cut tofu small.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Turkey Meatballs with Zucchini
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F / 200°C.
Mix turkey, panko and egg; shape small flattened meatballs.
Roast with zucchini half-moons for 18 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with fluffy couscous.

recipes.title: Chicken Sausage with Peppers & Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F / 220°C.
Roast potato chunks and pepper strips with oil for 20 minutes.
Add sausage and roast 12 minutes more.
Quarter the sausage lengthwise, then chop small — never serve coins.

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin with Apples & Butternut Squash
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F / 220°C.
Roast squash cubes and apple wedges with oil for 15 minutes.
Add pork tenderloin and roast 20 minutes to 145°F / 63°C; rest 5 minutes.
Slice pork very thin and chop small.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Cauliflower Sheet Pan with Yogurt
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F / 220°C.
Toss chickpeas, cauliflower and sweet potato with oil and mild spices.
Roast 25 minutes until soft.
Lightly mash the chickpeas and serve with Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Shrimp & Veggies with Rice
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F / 220°C.
Roast zucchini and pepper with oil for 12 minutes.
Add shrimp and roast 6–8 minutes until pink.
Chop shrimp small and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken & Veggie Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry thin chicken strips with garlic until cooked through.
Add finely chopped broccoli and grated carrot with a splash of water; cover and steam until soft.
Season with a drop of soy sauce and serve over rice, chopping the chicken small.

recipes.title: Ground Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Brown ground beef with grated ginger, breaking it into fine crumbles.
Add small broccoli florets and a splash of water; cover until soft.
Season lightly with soy sauce and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Tofu & Pea Stir-Fry
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes until golden.
Add peas and grated carrot; cook until soft.
Season with a drop of soy sauce and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Shrimp & Pea Fried Rice
steps: Scramble an egg and set aside.
Stir-fry finely chopped shrimp until pink, then add cold rice and peas.
Stir in the egg and a drop of soy sauce.

recipes.title: Sweet & Sour Pork with Pineapple
steps: Stir-fry thin pork strips until cooked through.
Add diced pineapple and pepper with a splash of pineapple juice and soy sauce; simmer until soft.
Chop small and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Veggie Lo Mein with Egg Noodles
steps: Cook egg noodles until soft.
Stir-fry grated carrot, zucchini and chopped mushrooms; add a scrambled egg.
Toss with noodles and a drop of soy sauce; cut noodles short.

recipes.title: Mild Chicken Korma
steps: Soften onion, then add chicken pieces and mild curry powder.
Simmer in coconut milk for 25 minutes until tender; stir in Greek yogurt off the heat.
Shred the chicken and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Spinach Curry
steps: Simmer chickpeas in tomatoes, coconut milk and mild curry powder for 15 minutes.
Stir in chopped spinach until wilted; mash some chickpeas.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Dal with Rice
steps: Simmer red lentils with onion, tomatoes and mild curry powder for 20 minutes until thick.
Stir in a little butter.
Serve over soft rice.

recipes.title: Coconut Fish Curry
steps: Simmer coconut milk, tomatoes and mild curry powder for 10 minutes.
Add fish pieces and poach 6–8 minutes until flaky; check for bones.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato & Chickpea Curry
steps: Simmer sweet potato cubes in coconut milk with mild curry powder for 15 minutes.
Add chickpeas and cook until everything is very soft.
Mash lightly and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash & Lentil Curry
steps: Simmer squash and red lentils in coconut milk and water with mild curry powder for 25 minutes.
Mash to a thick, soft stew.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Chicken Curry
steps: Soften onion, then add chicken, potato and carrot chunks.
Cover with water and mild curry powder; simmer 25 minutes until thick and soft.
Shred the chicken and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Beef Lasagna Roll-Ups
steps: Brown ground beef finely and mix with marinara.
Spread ricotta on cooked lasagna noodles, add beef sauce and roll up.
Top with sauce and mozzarella; bake at 375°F / 190°C for 25 minutes.
Slice each roll-up into rounds.

recipes.title: Chicken, Spinach & Ricotta Pasta Bake
steps: Toss cooked pasta with shredded chicken, spinach, ricotta and marinara.
Top with mozzarella and bake at 375°F / 190°C for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage & Kale Pasta Bake
steps: Brown sausage (casing removed) into fine crumbles with finely chopped kale.
Toss with pasta and marinara, top with mozzarella and bake 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
steps: Make a simple cheese sauce with butter, flour, milk and cheddar.
Fold in noodles, flaked tuna and peas.
Bake at 375°F / 190°C for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Lentil Bolognese
steps: Simmer brown lentils with grated carrot, onion and crushed tomatoes for 30 minutes.
Toss with soft pasta and top with parmesan.

recipes.title: Salmon & Pea Pasta Bake
steps: Make a light cheese sauce.
Fold in pasta, flaked salmon (bones removed) and peas.
Bake at 375°F / 190°C for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti with Turkey
steps: Brown ground turkey finely and simmer with marinara.
Layer with pasta and dollops of ricotta; top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F / 190°C for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Veggie Lasagna
steps: Layer lasagna noodles with marinara, ricotta, chopped spinach and grated zucchini.
Top with mozzarella and bake covered at 375°F / 190°C for 40 minutes.
