Rest 10 minutes before cutting small squares.

recipes.title: Shredded Chicken Soft Tacos
steps: Simmer chicken thighs with mild spices until tender and shred finely.
Warm soft tortillas (or rice) and add the filling with soft toppings.
For little ones, serve deconstructed or cut tacos into strips.

recipes.title: Flaky Fish Tacos with Yogurt Sauce
steps: Bake seasoned fish 10 minutes and flake, checking for bones; stir lemon into Greek yogurt.
Warm soft tortillas (or rice) and add the filling with soft toppings.
For little ones, serve deconstructed or cut tacos into strips.

recipes.title: Mild Beef Soft Tacos
steps: Brown ground beef finely with crushed tomatoes and mild spices.
Warm soft tortillas (or rice) and add the filling with soft toppings.
For little ones, serve deconstructed or cut tacos into strips.

recipes.title: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Tacos
steps: Mash roasted sweet potato with warm black beans.
Warm soft tortillas (or rice) and add the filling with soft toppings.
For little ones, serve deconstructed or cut tacos into strips.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork Tacos with Mango
steps: Use slow-cooked, finely pulled pork and diced ripe mango.
Warm soft tortillas (or rice) and add the filling with soft toppings.
For little ones, serve deconstructed or cut tacos into strips.

recipes.title: Shrimp & Corn Tacos
steps: Sauté finely chopped shrimp with corn until pink and cooked.
Warm soft tortillas (or rice) and add the filling with soft toppings.
For little ones, serve deconstructed or cut tacos into strips.

recipes.title: Lentil Tacos
steps: Simmer brown lentils with crushed tomatoes and mild spices until thick.
Warm soft tortillas (or rice) and add the filling with soft toppings.
For little ones, serve deconstructed or cut tacos into strips.

recipes.title: Turkey Taco Rice Bowls
steps: Brown ground turkey finely with mild spices and a little salsa.
Warm soft tortillas (or rice) and add the filling with soft toppings.
For little ones, serve deconstructed or cut tacos into strips.

recipes.title: Turkey Meatballs in Marinara with Spaghetti
steps: Mix turkey, panko, egg and parmesan; shape small flattened meatballs.
Simmer in marinara for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with spaghetti cut short; halve the meatballs.

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs with Egg Noodles
steps: Mix beef, pork, panko and egg; shape small meatballs and brown.
Simmer in broth 10 minutes; stir in Greek yogurt off the heat for a creamy sauce.
Serve over soft egg noodles; halve meatballs.

recipes.title: Chicken Spinach Meatballs with Orzo
steps: Mix chicken, chopped spinach, panko and egg; shape small meatballs.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 15 minutes.
Serve with orzo cooked in broth.

recipes.title: Mild Lamb Kofta with Yogurt & Couscous
steps: Mix lamb with grated onion and mild cumin; shape small flat patties.
Pan-cook until cooked through (160°F / 71°C).
Serve with couscous and a cucumber yogurt sauce.

recipes.title: Moroccan Beef Meatballs with Couscous
steps: Mix beef with mild cumin and cinnamon; shape small meatballs.
Simmer in crushed tomatoes with grated carrot for 20 minutes.
Serve over couscous.

recipes.title: Pork & Apple Meatballs with Mash
steps: Mix pork with grated apple, panko and egg; shape small meatballs.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 18 minutes.
Serve with creamy mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Beef & Sweet Potato Stew
steps: Brown beef chunks, then add onion, tomatoes and broth.
Simmer covered 1½ hours; add sweet potato and carrot for the last 30 minutes.
Shred the beef finely and mash veggies slightly.

recipes.title: Chicken & White Bean Stew
steps: Simmer chicken thighs with carrot in broth for 25 minutes.
Shred chicken, add white beans and spinach; simmer 10 minutes.
Mash a few beans to thicken.

recipes.title: Pork & Apple Braise with Mash
steps: Brown pork, add sliced apple, onion and broth.
Braise covered at 325°F / 165°C for 2½ hours until it pulls apart.
Shred finely and serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Vegetable Tagine
steps: Simmer chickpeas, sweet potato and carrot in tomatoes with mild cumin and cinnamon for 25 minutes.
Mash lightly.
Serve over couscous.

recipes.title: Mild Lamb Keema with Peas & Rice
steps: Brown ground lamb finely with mild curry powder.
Simmer with crushed tomatoes and peas for 15 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore with Polenta
steps: Brown chicken thighs; add tomatoes, peppers and mushrooms.
Simmer covered 35 minutes; shred chicken finely.
Serve over soft polenta.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Beef Ragù with Pasta
steps: Slow-cook beef with crushed tomatoes and grated carrot on low for 8 hours.
Shred the beef very finely into the sauce.
Toss with soft pasta and parmesan.

recipes.title: Brazilian-Style Black Bean Stew
steps: Simmer black beans with sweet potato, pepper and mild spices for 25 minutes.
Mash to a thick stew.
Serve with rice and mandarin segments on the side.

recipes.title: Baked Cod with Lemon Butter & Rice
steps: Bake cod with lemon and a little butter at 400°F / 200°C for 12 minutes.
Flake and check for bones.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Salmon Teriyaki with Rice & Edamame
steps: Brush salmon with low-sodium soy sauce and honey (12 months+).
Bake 12 minutes; flake and check for bones.
Serve with rice and smashed edamame.

recipes.title: Cozy Fish Pie with Mash Topping
steps: Poach fish in milk, then flake and check for bones.
Mix with peas and a little of the milk; top with mashed potato.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy White Fish Chowder
steps: Simmer diced potato in broth until soft.
Add milk, corn and fish pieces; simmer 6 minutes until flaky.
Blend a little for thickness and check for bones.

recipes.title: Poached Salmon with Dill Yogurt & Potatoes
steps: Poach salmon in simmering water for 10 minutes; flake and check for bones.
Serve with boiled potatoes and soft green beans.
Top with Greek yogurt mixed with dill.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Baked Fish with Tomatoes & Couscous
steps: Bake fish with quartered cherry tomatoes, zucchini and olive oil at 400°F / 200°C for 15 minutes.
Flake the fish and check for bones.
Serve over couscous.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Shredded Chicken with Rice & Peas
steps: Bake chicken thighs with lemon and herbs for 30 minutes until 165°F / 74°C.
Shred finely.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken with Rice
steps: Simmer chicken pieces in honey (12 months+), garlic and a little soy sauce until tender.
Shred and serve over rice with soft broccoli.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan Bites with Spaghetti
steps: Cut chicken into small flat pieces, coat in egg and parmesan-panko.
Bake at 425°F / 220°C for 12 minutes, top with marinara and mozzarella, and bake 3 more minutes.
Serve with short spaghetti.

recipes.title: Mini Chicken Pot Pies
steps: Make a creamy sauce with butter, flour, broth and milk; stir in shredded chicken and mixed veg.
Spoon into ramekins and top with a simple biscuit dough (flour, butter, milk).
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken & Rice Casserole
steps: Mix cooked rice, shredded chicken, chopped broccoli, milk and cheddar.
Bake at 375°F / 190°C for 25 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Mild Chicken Shawarma Bowls
steps: Marinate chicken in Greek yogurt and mild spices; bake 25 minutes.
Shred finely.
Serve with rice, peeled cucumber, yogurt sauce and soft pita strips.

recipes.title: Mild Butter Chicken with Rice
steps: Simmer chicken pieces in tomatoes, butter and mild curry powder for 25 minutes.
Stir in Greek yogurt off the heat.
Shred and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Spanish-Style Chicken & Rice
steps: Brown chicken pieces, then add rice, tomatoes, peppers and mild paprika with water.
Cover and simmer 25 minutes; add peas at the end.
Shred chicken into the rice.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie
steps: Brown lamb finely with mixed veg and a splash of broth.
Top with creamy mashed potato.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Mild Beef Stroganoff
steps: Brown ground beef with finely chopped mushrooms and onion.
Simmer with broth, then stir in Greek yogurt off the heat.
Serve over soft egg noodles.

recipes.title: Pot Roast with Root Veggies
steps: Brown beef, then add broth, onion, potatoes and carrots.
Braise covered at 325°F / 165°C for 3 hours until fork-tender.
Shred the beef finely and mash veggies slightly.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joe Sliders
steps: Brown ground beef finely with diced pepper and onion.
Simmer with crushed tomatoes until thick.
Serve on small bread rounds, open-faced, cut in half.

recipes.title: Mini Meatloaf Muffins
steps: Mix beef, oats, egg and grated carrot; press into a muffin tin.
Top with marinara and bake at 375°F / 190°C for 20 minutes.
Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Mild Beef & Bean Chili
steps: Brown beef finely with diced pepper.
Simmer with beans, tomatoes and mild spices for 25 minutes; mash some beans.
Top with cheese and Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Beef & Veggie Fried Rice
steps: Brown beef finely and set aside.
Stir-fry cold rice with mixed veg and a scrambled egg.
Stir in the beef and a drop of soy sauce.

recipes.title: Mild Korean-Style Beef Bowl
steps: Brown ground beef with garlic and finely grated pear.
Season with a little low-sodium soy sauce.
Serve over rice with peeled cucumber.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork with Sweet Potato Mash
steps: Slow-cook pork with applesauce and mild paprika on low for 8 hours.
Pull apart very finely.
Serve with mashed sweet potato and soft green beans.

recipes.title: Pork Medallions with Applesauce & Potatoes
steps: Sear thin pork medallions until cooked to 145°F / 63°C; rest and chop small.
Serve with warm applesauce, roasted potatoes and green beans.

recipes.title: Pork & Ginger Noodle Bowl
steps: Brown pork finely with grated ginger.
Add broth, noodles and spinach; simmer until soft.
Season lightly with soy sauce; cut noodles short.

recipes.title: Ham & Pea Risotto
steps: Toast rice in butter and add broth gradually, stirring, for 20 minutes.
Stir in finely diced ham, peas and parmesan.

recipes.title: Black Bean Enchiladas
steps: Fill tortillas with mashed black beans, sweet potato and cheese; roll up.
Cover with mildly spiced tomato sauce and more cheese.
Bake at 375°F / 190°C for 20 minutes; cut into small pieces.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu Katsu with Rice
steps: Slice pressed tofu into slabs, dip in egg and panko.
Bake at 425°F / 220°C for 20 minutes until crisp.
Cut into strips; serve with rice and steamed carrot.

recipes.title: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
steps: Simmer brown lentils with carrot, peas and tomatoes until thick.
Top with mashed potato.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Veggie Quinoa Chili
steps: Simmer quinoa, beans, tomatoes, corn and pepper with mild spices for 25 minutes.
Mash some beans to thicken.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
steps: Soften finely chopped onion and mushrooms in butter.
Add rice and broth gradually, stirring, for 20 minutes.
Stir in parmesan.

recipes.title: Bean & Cheese Burritos
steps: Fill tortillas with refried beans, rice and cheese.
Roll and toast seam-side down until golden.
Cut into 1-inch rounds; serve with mild salsa.

recipes.title: Mild Kitchari
steps: Simmer red lentils and rice with diced carrot and a pinch of turmeric for 30 minutes until porridge-like.
Stir in a little butter.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Cheese Bake
steps: Steam cauliflower until very soft.
Cover with cheese sauce and bake at 400°F / 200°C for 15 minutes.
Serve with toast fingers.

recipes.title: Ricotta Gnudi with Tomato Sauce
steps: Mix ricotta, egg, parmesan and a little flour into a soft dough.
Shape small dumplings and simmer 3–4 minutes until they float.
Serve with warm marinara.

recipes.title: Spanakopita-Style Tortilla Bake
steps: Mix chopped spinach, feta, ricotta and egg.
Layer between tortillas in a baking dish.
Bake at 375°F / 190°C for 20 minutes; cut into small squares.

recipes.title: Black Bean Burgers
steps: Mash black beans with oats, egg and mild spices; shape small flat patties.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 18 minutes.
Serve on bread rounds with mashed avocado, cut in half.

recipes.title: Tofu Bibimbap with Egg
steps: Arrange rice with sautéed spinach, grated carrot and pan-fried tofu.
Top with a fully cooked fried egg cut into strips.
Add a drop of low-sodium soy sauce and mix.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Chicken Orzo
steps: Brown chicken pieces, then simmer with orzo, broth and lemon for 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach and crumbled feta.
Shred the chicken into the orzo.

recipes.title: Caribbean Rice & Peas with Chicken
steps: Simmer rice and kidney beans in coconut milk and water with mild thyme and allspice.
Bake chicken thighs alongside; shred finely.
Serve together.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken & Couscous
steps: Simmer chicken with carrots, mild cumin and cinnamon for 25 minutes.
Shred chicken and serve over couscous with a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata Strips with Pasta
steps: Pound chicken thin, dust in flour and pan-cook until done.
Make a quick lemon-butter sauce with broth.
Cut chicken into thin strips and serve with pasta.

recipes.title: Jamaican-Style Mild Beef Patties
steps: Cook ground beef finely with mild curry powder and thyme.
Wrap in a simple pastry (flour, butter, water) and crimp.
Bake at 400°F / 200°C for 25 minutes; cut into strips.

recipes.title: Steamed Egg Custard with Rice
steps: Whisk 2 eggs with ¾ cup warm broth and strain.
Steam gently for 12 minutes until silky and set.
Serve with soft rice and smashed peas.

recipes.title: Mild Chicken Noodle Pho
steps: Simmer chicken in broth with ginger for 25 minutes; shred finely.
Cook noodles in the broth and cut them short.
Top with a little fresh herbs.

recipes.title: Peruvian-Style Chicken & Potatoes
steps: Rub chicken with mild paprika, cumin and lemon; roast with potato wedges for 35 minutes.
Shred chicken and serve with a lemony yogurt sauce.

recipes.title: Mild Chicken Adobo
steps: Simmer chicken in water with a little soy sauce, garlic and a bay leaf for 30 minutes.
Shred finely and spoon sauce over rice.
Serve with soft green beans.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken & Pineapple Rice
steps: Cook diced chicken with pineapple and pepper until tender.
Toss with rice and a drop of soy sauce.
Chop everything small.

recipes.title: German Potato Pancakes with Applesauce
steps: Grate and squeeze potatoes; mix with egg and flour.
Pan-fry small, thin pancakes until golden and cooked through.
Serve with applesauce and Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Ratatouille with White Beans
steps: Simmer diced zucchini and pepper in tomatoes and olive oil for 30 minutes until very soft.
Stir in white beans.
Serve with toast for dipping.

recipes.title: Moussaka-Style Lamb & Potato Bake
steps: Brown lamb finely and simmer with tomatoes.
Layer with thin cooked potato slices and top with a cheesy white sauce.
Bake at 375°F / 190°C for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spanish Potato Tortilla
steps: Gently cook thin potato and onion slices in olive oil until very soft.
Add 4 beaten eggs and cook low until set; flip to finish.
Cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Cheesy Spinach Waffles & Eggs
steps: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, baking powder, shredded cheese and chopped spinach into a batter.
Cook in a waffle iron until golden.
Serve in strips with a soft-scrambled egg.

recipes.title: Breakfast-for-Dinner Hash
steps: Pan-fry small potato cubes until soft and golden.
Add crumbled sausage (casing removed) and diced pepper; cook through.
Top with a fully cooked egg, chopped.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs, Toast Strips & Banana
steps: Whisk 1–2 eggs with a splash of milk; cook low and slow until soft curds form.
Fold in 1 tbsp shredded cheddar off the heat.
Toast 1 slice whole-wheat bread and cut into 3–4 finger strips.
Dice ripe banana into soft ½-inch pieces.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt with Mashed Berries, Honey & Cinnamon
steps: Spoon ½ cup plain Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Mash a small handful of berries with a fork and swirl them in.
Drizzle ½ tsp honey (12 months+ only) and dust with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Turkey & Cheese Roll-Ups, Edamame & Cucumber Sticks
steps: Lay a slice of low-sodium turkey or chicken flat, top with a thin slice of cheese, and roll tightly.
Slice roll-ups into ½-inch pinwheels.
Steam ¼ cup shelled edamame 4–5 min until very soft, then lightly smash.
Peel the cucumber and cut into thin sticks.

recipes.title: Thin Apple/Pear Slices with Peanut Butter
steps: Peel and core; slice into very thin wedges (steam 2 min for extra softness).
Spread a thin smear of natural peanut butter on each slice.

recipes.title: Baked Flaky Salmon, Mashed Sweet Potato & Soft Broccoli
steps: Bake salmon at 400°F / 200°C for 12–15 min until it flakes easily.
Flake into small pieces and check carefully for pin bones.
Mash roasted sweet potato with a little butter.
Steam broccoli florets 5–6 min until fork-tender; cut into small trees.

recipes.title: Warm Nut-Butter Oatmeal with Diced Mango
steps: Simmer ⅓ cup oats in ⅔ cup milk for 5 min until creamy.
Stir in 1 tsp nut butter until fully melted in (no clumps).
Top with soft diced mango or peach; cool to warm.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese with Soft Pineapple or Melon
steps: Spoon ⅓ cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Dice ripe pineapple or melon into small, soft pieces and fold in.

recipes.title: Black Bean & Cheese Quesadilla Triangles with Avocado
steps: Mash ¼ cup rinsed black beans with a fork.
Spread on half a tortilla, sprinkle with cheese, fold, and toast 2–3 min per side.
Cool slightly; cut into small triangles.
Serve with diced ripe avocado.

recipes.title: Sliced Hard-Boiled Egg with Whole-Grain Crackers
steps: Peel a hard-boiled egg from batch prep.
Slice into thin rounds or chop finely.
Serve with 3–4 whole-grain crackers.

recipes.title: Mild Turkey Bolognese with Rotini & Peas
steps: Brown 1 lb lean ground turkey, breaking it into very fine crumbles.
Simmer with passata and finely grated carrot for 15 min; skip added salt.
Cook rotini slightly past al dente for easy chewing.
Toss with sauce, top with grated parmesan, and serve with soft-steamed peas.
Cook once, serve twice: refrigerate half the pasta and sauce for Day 3 lunch.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Soft Oats & Strawberries
steps: Soak 2 tbsp oats in a splash of milk for 5 min (or overnight) until soft.
Layer with Greek yogurt.
Top with hulled, quartered strawberries.

recipes.title: Small Cheddar Cubes & Quartered Grapes
steps: Cut aged cheddar into small cubes or thin sticks.
Slice grapes lengthwise into quarters.

recipes.title: Leftover Turkey Bolognese with Soft Bell Pepper Strips
steps: Reheat Day 2 Bolognese until steaming (165°F / 74°C), then cool to warm.
Steam bell pepper strips 4 min until soft and bendable.

recipes.title: Mashed Chickpea Hummus with Soft Pita Triangles
steps: Blend rinsed chickpeas with olive oil, lemon, and a splash of water until very smooth.
Warm pita and cut into small triangles for dipping.

recipes.title: Braised Shredded Chicken Thighs, Rice, Beans & Plantain
steps: Braise 1.5 lb skinless thighs in low-sodium broth with garlic and cumin for 35–40 min.
Shred with two forks into thin strands.
Serve with rice, lightly mashed black beans, and soft roasted plantain or steamed carrot half-moons.
Cook once, serve twice: set aside 1 cup chicken, rice, and beans for Day 5 lunch.

recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Banana Egg Pancakes with Yogurt Dip
steps: Blend 1 ripe banana, 2 eggs, and 2 tbsp rolled oats until smooth.
Cook silver-dollar pancakes over medium-low, 1–2 min per side.
Cut into strips and serve with a Greek yogurt dip.

recipes.title: Steamed Edamame & Mandarin Segments
steps: Steam shelled edamame until very soft; halve or smash.
Peel mandarin segments and cut each in half.

recipes.title: Mild Tuna Salad Bread Fingers with Cherry Tomatoes
steps: Mix drained tuna with a spoon of Greek yogurt (or mayo) until creamy.
Spread on bread and cut into fingers.
Slice cherry tomatoes lengthwise into quarters.

recipes.title: Green Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend ½ cup milk, ¼ cup Greek yogurt, a handful of baby spinach, ½ banana, and 1 tsp peanut butter.
Blend until completely smooth; serve in an open or straw cup.

recipes.title: Thick Red Lentil & Vegetable Stew with Buttered Toast
steps: Simmer 1 cup rinsed red lentils with diced carrot and crushed tomatoes for 20 min until thick and soft.
Mash lightly for a smoother texture.
Serve warm with buttered toast strips for dipping.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast Fingers, Cheesy Eggs & Blueberries
steps: Mash avocado onto toast; sprinkle with hemp seeds and cut into fingers.
Soft-scramble eggs with a little cheddar.
Halve or smash blueberries.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese with Banana & Cinnamon
steps: Top ⅓ cup cottage cheese (or Greek yogurt) with sliced banana and a pinch of cinnamon.

recipes.title: Deconstructed Burrito Bowl (Day 3 Chicken)
steps: Reheat Day 3 shredded chicken, rice, and beans until steaming, then cool to warm.
Arrange in separate piles; top with shredded cheddar and a Greek yogurt dollop.

recipes.title: Crackers with Thin Almond Butter & Raspberries
steps: Spread a thin smear of almond butter on whole-grain crackers.
Serve with soft raspberries, torn in half.

recipes.title: Homemade White Fish Fingers, Potato Wedges & Green Beans
steps: Cut cod or tilapia into strips; dip in beaten egg, then panko.
Pan-sear in a little oil, 2–3 min per side, until opaque and flaky.
Roast potato wedges at 425°F / 220°C for 25 min until soft inside.
Steam green beans until very tender; cut into short pieces.

prepTasks.title: Hard-boil 4 eggs
prepTasks.detail: 12 min. Peel and refrigerate for the Day 2 snack and extra protein.

prepTasks.title: Cook a base grain
prepTasks.detail: Make 2 cups rice. Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate for Day 3 and Day 5.

prepTasks.title: Wash & quarter produce
prepTasks.detail: Quarter grapes and cherry tomatoes lengthwise; hull and quarter strawberries.

prepTasks.title: Steam & portion edamame
prepTasks.detail: Steam the whole bag, lightly smash, and portion for Day 1 and Day 4.

prepTasks.title: Roast sweet potatoes
prepTasks.detail: Roast 2 whole sweet potatoes for tonight's mash.

prepTasks.title: Make a double batch of Bolognese
prepTasks.detail: Refrigerate half for Day 3 lunch (use within 3–4 days).

prepTasks.title: Shred extra chicken thighs
prepTasks.detail: Store 1 cup chicken with rice and beans for the Day 5 burrito bowl.

prepTasks.title: Rinse red lentils
prepTasks.detail: No soaking needed. Rinse until the water runs clear.

prepTasks.title: Thaw white fish
prepTasks.detail: Move cod or tilapia from freezer to fridge for tomorrow's fish fingers.
